# KAYAK Canada

> > KAYAK Canada is a comprehensive travel search engine that helps Canadians compare and book flights, hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages across hundreds of travel sites.

KAYAK Canada (ca.kayak.com) aggregates pricing from major hotel chains like IHG, car rental companies including Thrifty, Dollar, and Enterprise, and features extensive listings for destinations worldwide. The platform specializes in SUV rentals featuring vehicles from Kia, Mitsubishi, Audi, Porsche, Land Rover, Toyota, and BMW, alongside comprehensive hotel directories for beach resorts, hostels, and urban accommodations.

## Key Topics

- Travel comparison and search
- Hotel directories and accommodation listings
- SUV and car rental deals
- Beach resorts and vacation destinations
- Rental companies (Thrifty, Dollar, Enterprise)
- IHG hotel chain properties
- International destinations (Beirut, Donegal, Clearwater Beach)
- SUV models (Kia Sportage, Mitsubishi Outlander, Toyota RAV4, BMW X5)
- Luxury SUVs (Audi Q8, Porsche Macan, Land Rover Range Rover Sport)
- Hostel accommodations
- Pricing and deal comparison
- Australian destinations (Canberra, Broadbeach)
- Florida beach hotels
- Budget travel options
